ipa: /ənd ˈaʊɚ mˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈʌlsɪv pɹˈɛzənt sˈɛlvz/

text: You know, we all want to be someone who has watched "Rashomon,"
ipa: /jˈu nˈoʊ wˈi ˈɔl wˈɑnt tˈu bˈi sˈʌmwˌʌn hˈu hˈæz wˈɑtʃt rashomon/

text: but right now we want to watch "Ace Ventura" for the fourth time.
ipa: /bˈʌt ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ wˈi wˈɑnt tˈu wˈɑtʃ ˈeɪs vɛntʃˈɝə fˈɔɹ ðə fˈɔɹθ tˈaɪm/

text: (Laughter) So the best editing gives us a bit of both.
ipa: /lˈæftɚ sˈoʊ ðə bˈɛst ˈɛdətɪŋ ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə bˈɪt ˈʌv bˈoʊθ/

text: It gives us a little bit of Justin Bieber and a little bit of Afghanistan.
ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv dʒˈʌstən bˈibɚ ənd ə lˈɪtəl bˈɪt ˈʌv æfɡˈænəstˌæn/

text: It gives us some information vegetables; it gives us some information dessert.
ipa: /ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən vˈɛdʒtəbəlz ˈɪt ɡˈɪvz ˈʌs sˈʌm ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dɪzˈɝt/

text: And the challenge with these kinds of algorithmic filters, these personalized filters,
ipa: /ənd ðə tʃˈæləndʒ wˈɪð ðˈiz kˈaɪndz ˈʌv ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk fˈɪltɚz ðˈiz pˈɝsənəlˌaɪzd fˈɪltɚz/

text: is that, because they're mainly looking at what you click on first,
ipa: /ˈɪz ðˈæt bɪkˈɔz ðˈɛɹ mˈeɪnli lˈʊkɪŋ ˈæt wˈʌt jˈu klˈɪk ˈɑn fˈɝst/

text: it can throw off that balance.
ipa: /ˈɪt kˈæn θɹˈoʊ ˈɔf ðˈæt bˈæləns/

text: And instead of a balanced information diet, you can end up surrounded by information junk food.
ipa: /ənd ˌɪnstˈɛd ˈʌv ə bˈælənst ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dˈaɪət jˈu kˈæn ˈɛnd ˈʌp sɚˈaʊndɪd bˈaɪ ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən dʒˈʌŋk fˈud/

text: What this suggests is actually that we may have the story about the Internet wrong.
ipa: /wˈʌt ðˈɪs sədʒˈɛsts ˈɪz ˈæktʃˌuəli ðˈæt wˈi mˈeɪ hˈæv ðə stˈɔɹi əbˈaʊt ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ɹˈɔŋ/

text: In a broadcast society this is how the founding mythology goes in a broadcast society,
ipa: /ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti ðˈɪs ˈɪz hˈaʊ ðə fˈaʊndɪŋ məθˈɑlədʒˌi ɡˈoʊz ɪn ə bɹˈɔdkˌæst səsˈaɪəti/

text: there were these gatekeepers, the editors, and they controlled the flows of information.
ipa: /ðˈɛɹ wˈɝ ðˈiz ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz ənd ðˈeɪ kəntɹˈoʊld ðə flˈoʊz ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

text: And along came the Internet and it swept them out of the way,
ipa: /ənd əlˈɔŋ kˈeɪm ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt ənd ˈɪt swˈɛpt ðˈɛm ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə wˈeɪ/

text: and it allowed all of us to connect together, and it was awesome.
ipa: /ənd ˈɪt əlˈaʊd ˈɔl ˈʌv ˈʌs tˈu kənˈɛkt təɡˈɛðɚ ənd ˈɪt wˈɑz ˈɑsəm/

text: But that's not actually what's happening right now.
ipa: /bˈʌt ðˈæts nˈɑt ˈæktʃˌuəli wˈʌts hˈæpənɪŋ ɹˈaɪt nˈaʊ/

text: What we're seeing is more of a passing of the torch from human
ipa: /wˈʌt wˈiɹ sˈiɪŋ ˈɪz mˈɔɹ ˈʌv ə pˈæsɪŋ ˈʌv ðə tˈɔɹtʃ fɹˈʌm hjˈumən/

text: gatekeepers to algorithmic ones.
ipa: /ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmɪk wˈʌnz/

text: And the thing is that the algorithms don't yet have the kind of embedded ethics
ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz ðˈæt ðə ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz dˈoʊnt jˈɛt hˈæv ðə kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɛmbˈɛdɪd ˈɛθɪks/

text: that the editors did.
ipa: /ðˈæt ðə ˈɛdɪtɚz dˈɪd/

text: So if algorithms are going to curate the world for us,
ipa: /sˈoʊ ˈɪf ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz ˈɑɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu kjˈʊɹət ðə wˈɝld fˈɔɹ ˈʌs/

text: if they're going to decide what we get to see
ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈɛɹ ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt wˈi ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi/

text: and what we don't get to see, then we need to make sure
ipa: /ənd wˈʌt wˈi dˈoʊnt ɡˈɛt tˈu sˈi ðˈɛn wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

text: that they're not just keyed to relevance.
ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ nˈɑt dʒˈʌst kˈid tˈu ɹˈɛləvəns/

text: We need to make sure that they also show us things
ipa: /wˈi nˈid tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈeɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ʃˈoʊ ˈʌs θˈɪŋz/

text: that are uncomfortable or challenging or important.
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɑɹ ənkˈʌmfɚtəbəl ˈɔɹ tʃˈæləndʒɪŋ ˈɔɹ ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

text: This is what TED does other points of view.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ˈɪz wˈʌt tˈɛd dˈʌz ˈʌðɚ pˈɔɪnts ˈʌv vjˈu/

text: And the thing is, we've actually been here before as a society.
ipa: /ənd ðə θˈɪŋ ˈɪz wˈiv ˈæktʃˌuəli bˈɪn hˈiɹ bɪfˈɔɹ ˈæz ə səsˈaɪəti/

text: In 1915, it's not like newspapers were sweating a lot about their civic responsibilities.
ipa: /ɪn 1915 ˈɪts nˈɑt lˈaɪk nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ swˈɛtɪŋ ə lˈɑt əbˈaʊt ðˈɛɹ sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪlətiz/

text: Then people noticed that they were doing something really important
ipa: /ðˈɛn pˈipəl nˈoʊtəst ðˈæt ðˈeɪ wˈɝ dˈuɪŋ sˈʌmθɪŋ ɹˈɪli ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt/

text: that, in fact, you couldn't have a functioning democracy
ipa: /ðˈæt ɪn fˈækt jˈu kˈʊdənt hˈæv ə fˈʌŋkʃənɪŋ dɪmˈɑkɹəsi/

text: if citizens didn't get a good flow of information,
ipa: /ˈɪf sˈɪtəzənz dˈɪdənt ɡˈɛt ə ɡˈʊd flˈoʊ ˈʌv ˌɪnfɚmˈeɪʃən/

text: that the newspapers were critical because they were acting as the filter,
ipa: /ðˈæt ðə nˈuzpˌeɪpɚz wˈɝ kɹˈɪtɪkəl bɪkˈɔz ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ˈæktɪŋ ˈæz ðə fˈɪltɚ/

text: and then journalistic ethics developed.
ipa: /ənd ðˈɛn dʒˌɝnəlˈɪstɪk ˈɛθɪks dɪvˈɛləpt/

text: It wasn't perfect, but it got us through the last century.
ipa: /ˈɪt wˈɑzənt pɚfˈɛkt bˈʌt ˈɪt ɡˈɑt ˈʌs θɹˈu ðə lˈæst sˈɛntʃɚi/

text: And so now, we're kind of back in 1915 on the Web.
ipa: /ənd sˈoʊ nˈaʊ wˈiɹ kˈaɪnd ˈʌv bˈæk ɪn 1915 ˈɑn ðə wˈɛb/

text: And we need the new gatekeepers to encode
ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid ðə nˈu ɡˈeɪtkˌipɚz tˈu ɛnkˈoʊd/

text: that kind of responsibility into the code that they're writing.
ipa: /ðˈæt kˈaɪnd ˈʌv ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti ˈɪntu ðə kˈoʊd ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ɹˈaɪtɪŋ/

text: I know that there are a lot of people here from Facebook
ipa: /ˈaɪ nˈoʊ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ ˈɑɹ ə lˈɑt ˈʌv pˈipəl hˈiɹ fɹˈʌm fˈeɪsbˌʊk/

text: and from Google Larry and Sergey people who have helped build the Web
ipa: /ənd fɹˈʌm ɡˈuɡəl lˈɛɹi ənd sˈɛɹdʒi pˈipəl hˈu hˈæv hˈɛlpt bˈɪld ðə wˈɛb/

text: as it is, and I'm grateful for that.
ipa: /ˈæz ˈɪt ˈɪz ənd ˈaɪm ɡɹˈeɪtfəl fˈɔɹ ðˈæt/

text: But we really need you to make sure
ipa: /bˈʌt wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ/

text: that these algorithms have encoded in them a sense of the public life,
ipa: /ðˈæt ðˈiz ˈælɡɚˌɪðəmz hˈæv ɛnkˈoʊdɪd ɪn ðˈɛm ə sˈɛns ˈʌv ðə pˈʌblɪk lˈaɪf/

text: a sense of civic responsibility.
ipa: /ə sˈɛns ˈʌv sˈɪvɪk ɹispˌɑnsəbˈɪləti/

text: We need you to make sure that they're transparent enough
ipa: /wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu mˈeɪk ʃˈʊɹ ðˈæt ðˈɛɹ tɹænspˈɛɹənt ɪnˈʌf/

text: that we can see what the rules are that determine what gets through our filters.
ipa: /ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn sˈi wˈʌt ðə ɹˈulz ˈɑɹ ðˈæt dətˈɝmən wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ˈaʊɚ fˈɪltɚz/

text: And we need you to give us some control
ipa: /ənd wˈi nˈid jˈu tˈu ɡˈɪv ˈʌs sˈʌm kəntɹˈoʊl/

text: so that we can decide what gets through and what doesn't.
ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈæt wˈi kˈæn dˌɪsˈaɪd wˈʌt ɡˈɛts θɹˈu ənd wˈʌt dˈʌzənt/

text: Because I think we really need the Internet
ipa: /bɪkˈɔz ˈaɪ θˈɪŋk wˈi ɹˈɪli nˈid ðə ˈɪntɚnˌɛt/

text: to be that thing that we all dreamed of it being.
ipa: /tˈu bˈi ðˈæt θˈɪŋ ðˈæt wˈi ˈɔl dɹˈimd ˈʌv ˈɪt bˈiɪŋ/

text: We need it to connect us all together.
ipa: /wˈi nˈid ˈɪt tˈu kənˈɛkt ˈʌs ˈɔl təɡˈɛðɚ/

text: We need it to introduce us to new ideas and new people and different perspectives.
ipa: /wˈi nˈid ˈɪt tˈu ˌɪntɹədˈus ˈʌs tˈu nˈu aɪdˈiəz ənd nˈu pˈipəl ənd dˈɪfɚənt pɚspˈɛktɪvz/

text: And it's not going to do
ipa: /ənd ˈɪts nˈɑt ɡˈoʊɪŋ tˈu dˈu/

text: that if it leaves us all isolated in a Web of one. Thank you. (Applause)
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɪf ˈɪt lˈivz ˈʌs ˈɔl ˈaɪsəlˌeɪtəd ɪn ə wˈɛb ˈʌv wˈʌn θˈæŋk jˈu əplˈɔz/
